description: This file defines a set of Zustand stores for managing a hierarchical notebook tree structure, including functions for adding, removing, and updating notebooks and their tree representation, as well as managing expanded state and selection within a notes application.

methods.name: removeTreeItem
methods.description: Recursively removes a tree item and its children from the tree array based on the provided ID.

methods.name: createNotebookTreeStores
methods.description: Creates and returns Zustand stores for managing notebook tree state, selection, and expansion, with persistence support.
